reviews.text: This COSRX cream is so good. I bought it because of my acne prone skin going crazy. It helped me so much. It made my skin less swollen and helped me to ease the pain meanwhile making the pimples smaller in a quick period of time. It does leave a little bit of a white cast, so be sure to use it rather at night. I will be buying it again and would recommend it to everyone who's struggling with acne.
reviews.zh: 呢款 COSRX 面霜好好。我因為易生暗瘡嘅皮膚爆到好嚴重而買咗佢。佢幫咗我好多。令我嘅皮膚腫脹減少，亦減輕咗痛楚，同時喺短時間內令粒痘縮細。佢會留少少白霜，所以最好係晚上用。我會再買，亦會推薦畀所有為暗瘡所困擾嘅人。

reviews.text: If you are looking for a holy grail item, this is the one. I have purchase this item over and over again. It never fails to amaze how it reduces my redness from acne and calms it down the next day. It does pills and takes some time for it to be absorbed. So avoiding using it under making or during the daytime because it does leave a white cast. But at night, the next morning, it brings out the head of cystic acne or reduces the inflammation of the acne.
reviews.zh: 如果你想搵一件「holy grail」產品，就係呢個。我一買再買。佢總係令我驚嘆，可以減少暗瘡引致嘅紅位，而且第二日就可以令紅位平靜落嚟。佢會起搓，而且要用少少時間先會吸收。所以唔好喺化妝底下或者日間用，因為佢會留白。但係晚上用，第二日朝早，就會將囊腫性暗瘡嘅膿頭逼出嚟，或者減低暗瘡嘅紅腫。

reviews.text: I love this cream so much. Whenever my acne is starting to get bad or I have little bumps on my face that aren't red and painful but still seem like there's a hard kernel there, I put this on over night and it's instantly better the next morning. Now, I'm not going to say ALL my acne goes away but I can definitely see that they reduce in size and redness. This cream leaves a strong white cast though so definitely not for day time use. It's got a slightly whipped texture but still a bit heavy on the face (it doesn't dissolve away), and it's got a very light smell but nothing headache inducing.
reviews.zh: 我非常鍾意呢款面霜。每當我暗瘡開始變差，或者面上有啲細粒、唔紅唔痛，但係感覺好似入面有個硬核咁嘅時候，我就通宵塗呢款，第二朝就即刻好返。我唔會話所有暗瘡都會消失，不過我肯定見到佢哋縮細、紅位減少咗。呢款面霜會留好明顯嘅白霜，所以絕對唔適合日間用。佢質地有少少似打發咗嘅感覺，但塗喺面上仍然有啲厚（唔會溶走），而且香味好淡，唔會令人頭痛。

reviews.text:
It's smaller than you think it is, but it's not that bad
I use it on my acne zone at night and it actually helps my acnes to calm down a little bit and moisturize just enough

I have only used for a few days so far, and it hasn't given me any breakouts or hidden pimples (altho the cream is a bit thick)

A piece of advice: if you have enough money, you should buy it along with other cosrx acne products ( It will improve a lot )
reviews.zh:
佢比你以為嘅細，但係都唔算差。
我晚上喺暗瘡位置用，佢確實幫暗瘡稍為平靜落嚟，又有啱啱好嘅保濕效果。

我到目前為止只係用咗幾日，佢冇令我爆痘，亦冇令隱藏嘅粒痘出現（雖然面霜有少少厚）。

一個建議：如果你有足夠嘅預算，應該同其他 cosrx 暗瘡產品一齊買（佢會改善好多）。

reviews.text: À huge pimple (I'm talking planet sized) that randomly appeared on my chin was so painful to touch, and looked ginormous from the side, disappeared with this. When I received the cream it had been already started leaving but I noticed this time, the scarring is less prominent. The space where the pimple was is not as dark as the severity of the pimple would have made it be... Very happy with it.
reviews.zh: 下巴突然長咗一粒超大嘅痘（我係講好似行星咁大），痛到碰都碰唔得，側面睇落大到嚇人，用咗呢款就消失咗。收到面霜時，粒痘已經開始消退，不過呢次我留意到疤痕冇咁明顯。粒痘原本嗰個位置，色澤冇咁深，因為粒痘嗰時嘅嚴重程度，本來會令佢咁深……我好滿意。

reviews.text: This is honestly the best cream I stumbled upon. I heard of cosrx reputation for dealing with blemished skin and I honestly didn't really believe it because I thought my scars and redness are just part of my face that won't ever fade. But I was so wrong and I honestly didn't notice at first but slowly I decreased the makeup on my face to only bb cream and powder because my face just doesn't need concealer and foundation any more. I have mixed skin, but more on the oily side and I tap a little bit on my finger on the red spots and pimbles right before I go to bed. It has a creamy consistence which dries on the skin, so it sticks to it and when I wake up in the morning, most of it survived the night.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我偶然間搵到嘅最好面霜。我聽過 cosrx 處理瑕疵皮膚嘅名聲，但我老實講其實唔太相信，因為我以為我嘅疤痕同紅印係我面嘅一部分，永遠都唔會淡。但係我大錯特錯。我一開始冇留意到，但係慢慢地，我減少咗面上嘅化妝，只用 BB 霜同蜜粉，因為我嘅面再唔需要遮瑕膏同粉底。我嘅皮膚係混合性，偏油多啲，我瞓覺前會用手指輕輕點喺紅色嘅位置同暗瘡上。佢質地似奶霜，乾咗之後會貼住皮膚，所以當我朝早醒嚟，大部分都仲喺度，捱過咗一晚。

reviews.text:
After sifting through many single target spot treatments, from essential tea tree oil to Mario Badescu drying lotion, in comparison Centella blemish cream has definitely showcased the calmest and soothing results. I apply this cream during both day and night, but be aware this may leave a white cast, so if you don't wear makeup, I'd advice applying SPF to even out your complexion.
I have been using this product for 2 months now, safe to say that when combined with Centella Blemish Ampule. Both products maximise the healing properties of 'Centella', by reducing redness, and calming down inflamed areas, and soothing irritated or problematic areas from acne. 
I've done much scientific research on Centella Asiatica itself as a perennial​ herb, not only has it been traditionally used in Asian medicine for wound healing, but also it can be used to phytoremediate heavy metal. This only scratches the surface of this incredible plant, 'Centella' should be acknowledged as a superpower.
reviews.zh:
我試過好多針對單一問題嘅局部產品，由茶樹精油到 Mario Badescu 乾燥水，比較之下，Centella blemish cream 最令我感到平靜、舒緩嘅效果。我日間同晚上都會用呢款面霜，但要留意，佢可能會留白，所以如果你唔化妝，我建議你塗防曬，令膚色更均勻。
我用呢款產品已經兩個月，可以肯定，當同 Centella Blemish Ampule 一齊用，兩款產品會最大化「Centella」嘅療癒功效，減低紅位、舒緩發炎嘅位置，同埋舒緩受刺激或者因暗瘡而有問題嘅位置。
我對 Centella Asiatica 本身做咗好多科學研究，佢係一種多年生草本植物，唔單止喺亞洲醫學入面傳統上用嚟療傷，仲可以用嚟進行植物修復，吸收重金屬。呢個只係冰山一角，呢種神奇植物應該被視為一種「超能力」。

reviews.text: My initial thought when I had received it was that the tub is so tiny but to my surprise this little one does the wonder and really do works well in helping the skin with acne which i suffered from it quite a lot. I although apply all over my face as I do have a lot of acne and the result were quite pleasing as it does reduces my acne especially when i use it at night and when I woke up the next day I notice it reduces down dramatically. Over all this is a wonderful product worth buying if anyone has the same problem with acne like me.
reviews.zh: 我收到嗰時，第一個諗法係個罐好細，但係出乎意料，呢個細細個嘅產品真係好神奇，對於幫助我一直以來嘅暗瘡問題好有效。我雖然塗咗滿面，因為我嘅暗瘡好多，而結果都相當令人滿意，因為佢真係減少咗我嘅暗瘡，特別係我晚上用嘅時候；而第二日朝早醒嚟，我留意到暗瘡大幅減少。總括嚟講，如果有人同我一樣有暗瘡問題，呢個係一款好值得買嘅出色產品。
